snippet.title: GRAVEHEART — Official Announcement Teaser | Retro FPS
snippet.description:
William Wallace is back from the dead.

He kept the hair. Unfortunately, he also raised an army.

GRAVEHEART is a retro FPS set during an undead Scottish invasion of 1980s Britain. Fight through the hordes while your cursed weapons keep switching themselves at the worst possible moment.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5186960/Graveheart/

Demo coming to Steam Next Fest this October.

Developed by Vincent / 9000 Legends.
https://9000legends.com/

#Graveheart #RetroFPS #BoomerShooter
